privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Expand Matrix s.r.o. ("Expand Matrix", "we", "us") handles personal data when you visit our website, contact us or use our services.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
body: Expand Matrix s.r.o., Company ID (IČO) 23530596, with its registered office at Příčná 1892/4, Nové Město, 110 00 Prague 1, Czech Republic and registered in the Commercial Register kept by the Municipal Court in Prague, Section C, File 428062 (MSPH), is the controller of the personal data described below.
We are responsible for keeping your information secure and for ensuring that every processing step follows applicable EU and Czech legislation, especially the GDPR.

sections.heading: 2. Personal data we process
body: Identification and contact details that you share with us in forms, emails or during onboarding (name, company, role, phone number, billing details).
Service data such as project documentation, credentials or assets that you provide so we can deliver ordered services.
Technical data collected automatically through necessary cookies and analytics (device information, pages visited, interaction logs).

sections.heading: 3. Purposes and legal bases
body: Responding to your enquiries, preparing offers and performing contracts is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR.
Accounting, invoicing and records we must keep to comply with legal obligations rely on Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.
Improving services, protecting our systems and optional marketing communication are based on legitimate interest or your consent. You may object to legitimate interest processing at any time.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and analytics
body: We use essential cookies that keep the website secure and usable. Analytical and marketing cookies are activated only after you provide consent via the cookie banner.
You can withdraw or change your consent at any time through the cookie settings link in the footer, which will re-open the banner and let you choose again.

sections.heading: 5. Data sharing and retention
body: Personal data is stored on EU-based infrastructure providers that we have vetted and bound by processing agreements. When required for support, we may use suppliers seated outside the EU, but only with appropriate safeguards in place.
We retain personal data only for the time necessary to deliver the service, meet legal requirements or resolve claims. Afterwards the data is securely deleted or anonymised.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
body: You have the right to access, correct or delete your data, to request restriction or portability and to object to processing based on legitimate interest.
If you believe your rights have been infringed, you may lodge a complaint with the Czech Data Protection Authority, but we encourage you to contact us first so we can resolve the issue quickly.

privacy.contact: Questions regarding privacy can be sent to Expand Matrix s.r.o., info@expandmatrix.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms describe the basic rules that apply when you order consulting, AI development or digital services from Expand Matrix s.r.o.

sections.heading: 1. Scope of services
body: Our contracting party is Expand Matrix s.r.o., Company ID (IČO) 23530596, registered office Příčná 1892/4, Nové Město, 110 00 Prague 1, Czech Republic, registered with the Municipal Court in Prague, Section C, File 428062 (MSPH). All proposals and agreements you receive are issued on behalf of this entity.
We design, build and manage AI-driven and digital solutions according to the agreed proposal or statement of work.
Any changes to the agreed scope must be confirmed in writing, including the impact on price and timelines.

sections.heading: 2. Cooperation and responsibilities
body: You provide accurate inputs, timely feedback and the access necessary to deliver the project.
We keep you informed about progress, appoint a responsible contact person and handle your data with due care.

sections.heading: 3. Deliverables and approvals
body: Interim deliverables are shared for review. Unless you provide comments within the agreed review window, the deliverable is considered approved.
After acceptance we may use anonymised references for portfolio purposes unless you explicitly forbid it.

sections.heading: 4. Fees and payment
body: Prices are stated without VAT unless specified otherwise. Invoices are due within the period stated on the invoice, typically 14 days.
Late payments may be subject to statutory interest and we may pause work until outstanding invoices are settled.

sections.heading: 5. Confidentiality and intellectual property
body: Both parties treat all non-public information as confidential and use it only for fulfilling the contract.
Unless agreed otherwise, the client obtains a licence to use the deliverables for their internal needs after full payment; Expand Matrix retains underlying know-how and tools.

sections.heading: 6. Liability and governing law
body: Each party is liable for direct damages caused by proven breach, limited to the total amount paid for the relevant project. We are not liable for indirect or consequential loss.
The Terms are governed by Czech law and any disputes will be resolved amicably or before the courts in the Czech Republic.

terms.contact: Questions about these Terms? Contact us at info@expandmatrix.com.
